text: あなたは　いつも　なみのり　らくそうで　いいわね…　かったら　わたしに　ちょうだい！

structure.jp: なみのり　らくそうで
structure.en: look so at ease with Surf, and

structure.jp: わたしに　ちょうだい！

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (appearance)
patterns.explanation: そう stuck onto a describing word means 'looks like' it, judging by what you see. らくそう = 'looks easy and comfortable'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: で here is the joining form of words like らくそう, giving the reason for what follows. らくそうで　いい = 'it looks so easy, how nice for you'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on the end of a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens. かったら = 'if I win'.
